prompts.a:
Use case: logo-brand
Design a premium minimalist app logo of a PANCAKE STACK, unambiguously Western pancakes, not dorayaki, not sandwich, not burger. Exactly FOUR THIN pancake discs stacked tightly with clearly defined narrow gaps, each disc only about one tenth of the total stack width in thickness. Broad flat top surface, a TINY solid square pat of butter centered on top. Simple iconic side / slightly overhead view. No thick upper and lower buns, no fillings, no cream bands. Restrained clean graphic geometry, uniform bold rounded ink-brown contours, warm honey-gold pancake faces, pale yellow tiny square butter, three flat colors maximum. NO shading, NO gradients, NO texture, NO glossy 3D. Pancakes slightly offset by a small amount to feel crafted, but overall silhouette very compact and balanced. Four clearly readable thin layers, strong internal spacing. No star, no sparkle, no text, no plate, no utensils. It must work as a 32px software brand mark on white. Single centered symbol only, 80 percent of square canvas, true transparent background and smooth clean alpha edge. This is logo option A: crisp geometric stacked lines.
prompts.b:
Use case: logo-brand
One simple PANCAKE logo for a contemporary character design app called Pankeki. Direction B: bold monochrome-first stamp emblem, a lively three-quarter view of exactly THREE very THIN rounded pancake discs with an unmistakably small square pat of butter on the top. Three thin pancake layers individually separated by generous transparent negative-space lines. Strong dark warm brown silhouette with a SINGLE small honey-yellow butter accent, no additional color. Main body is a simple clean line-and-fill graphic, NOT realistic food, NOT thick dorayaki buns, NOT a cream-filled sandwich. Thin pancake disc thickness, wide shallow oval shapes, gentle rounded consistent curves. Butter is a tiny square, no sparkle. Asymmetrical but balanced, recognizable at 32 pixels. Flat solid color only, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no text, no framing circle, no utensils, no drip, no floating embellishments. Square transparent canvas, single symbol centered occupying 80 percent of it. Sharp clean professional alpha edges, fully opaque mark interior.
prompts.c_draft:
Use case: logo-brand
Create a distinct, memorable minimal logo for Pankeki: a small stack of exactly THREE THIN pancakes, using softly offset asymmetrical wavy contours. Friendly modern design-studio identity, hand-shaped but mathematically clean. A tiny square butter pat on the top makes it unmistakably pancakes. Pancake side profiles must be thin, broad and slightly irregular; do NOT depict thick dorayaki buns, bread, sandwich fillings, or a burger. The bottom and middle pancakes drift subtly in opposite directions, forming an elegant compact rhythm. Two colors ONLY: muted honey orange #D78C3B for all pancake shapes, deep espresso #3C2D23 for tiny butter pat and very minimal edge accents. Flat 2D graphic cut-paper silhouette, no outlines all around, no cream filling, no highlights, no shadow, no gradients, no surface texture, no star. Large transparent negative spaces between the three thin discs keep the layers distinct at 32 pixels. No plate, no dripping syrup, no text, no frame. Single icon centered on square transparent canvas at 80 percent size; clean antialiased alpha silhouette without stray pixels. This is direction C: soft asymmetric pancake ribbon mark. The result should be brandable and look different from a generic stock food icon.
prompts.rejectedMonogram:
Use case: logo-brand
Create a new professional minimalist symbol for Pankeki, a character design studio, as one transparent PNG. Direction A: a compact geometric pancake monogram. Two or three thick, softly rounded horizontal pancake layers interlock into a memorable upright silhouette with a subtle P-shaped negative space, without inserting a literal letter or word. The pancakes remain recognizable, but the result feels like a carefully designed software brand mark, not food illustration. Strong visual balance, consistent corner radii, generous internal gaps that remain legible at 32px. FLAT SOLID COLORS ONLY: deep warm ink #302D29 plus warm honey #DCA44D, at most two colors. No gradients, no shadows, no texture, no giant sparkle, no butter, no plate, no separate floating elements. No lettering or wordmark. Single symbol centered, occupying 75 percent of a square canvas with equal transparent margins. Fully opaque logo interior, truly transparent surrounding alpha background, pristine smooth edge without white fringe or stray pixels. Bold restrained professional identity.
